accesoTexto: Access lasts {{min}} minutes, applies only to shift scheduling and is recorded with your user.
avisoAntesDeEnviar: {{n}} workers below the monthly hours or above the guard limit
avisoHorasBloques: Blocks add up to {{suma}} h and the shift lasts {{horas}} h
avisoServicioRepetido: Same service twice on one day
avisoServicioRepetidoTexto: TuASUSALUD accepts one schedule per service and day; they will be merged on export.
datosDemoTexto: Workers, shifts and clock-in records are synthetic. Set fuenteDatos to "frappe" to read Frappe HR.
errorAcceso: The access could not be registered
errorBitacora: The change log could not be loaded
errorBloques: Two blocks of this shift overlap
errorCarga: The shifts could not be loaded
errorCargaTexto: Try again in a few minutes. If it persists, contact the HR unit.
errorCruceTexto: {{codigo}} overlaps with {{otros}}. A worker cannot have two shifts at the same time.
errorDiaOcupado: That day already has a shift
errorDiaOcupadoTexto: Day {{dia}} already has {{codigo}}. Edit that shift directly.
errorEstado: The schedule status could not be changed
errorExportar: The file could not be generated
errorGuardar: The shift could not be saved
errorParametros: The parameters could not be saved
errorRespuesta: Your answer could not be saved
errorSync: The synchronization status could not be loaded
errorTopeTexto: Already has {{n}} guard shifts this month; the limit for workers who joined in {{anio}} is {{tope}}.
faltaMotivo: Choose the reason for the change
fechaDelTurno: Shift date (change it to move the shift)
fueraDeHorizonte: This month cannot be scheduled yet: the limit is {{n}} months ahead ({{hasta}}).
fueraDeRed: Scheduling is only available inside the hospital network
fueraDeRedTexto: You can view the schedule. To change it from outside, request exceptional access and state the reason.
horasResultantes: With this change: {{horas}} h this month
leyendaCalendario: Hours below {{minimo}} and guard shifts above the limit are highlighted. Shifts that already started cannot be edited.
motivoAcceso: Why do you need to schedule from outside the hospital?
motivoCambio: Reason for the change (required: the schedule is published)
notaAsistencia: Clock-in records come from the ZKTeco time clock through Frappe HR. A record counts for a shift from 2 hours before it starts until 4 hours after it ends. Late arrivals and deductions are not calculated here.
observacion: What should the head of unit change?
observadosTexto: SUSALUD may reject them. Fix them in the worker record in Frappe HR before uploading the file.
paramAnioCorte: Last joining year counted as senior staff (RF29)
paramCache: Days of own shifts kept for offline use (RNF04)
paramGuardiasAntiguos: Guard shifts per month: senior staff (RF29)
paramGuardiasNuevos: Guard shifts per month: newer staff (RF29)
paramMesesAdelante: Months that can be scheduled ahead (RF01)
programadoEra: Scheduled: {{codigo}}. The schedule is kept; only what was executed changes.
reporteDiresaTexto: Two sheets: Registro (scheduled) and Ejecutado (as registered at month close).
reporteTuasusaludTexto: Fills the official SUSALUD template: one row per worker and service, {{n}} rows this month.
rolPublicado: Your schedule for this month has been published
rolPublicadoTexto: Check your shifts and confirm them, or tell your head of unit if you cannot attend.
sinConexion: No connection: showing the shifts saved on this device
sinConexionTexto: Saved on {{fecha}}. Read only: connect to confirm shifts or see changes.
sinPublicarTexto: TuASUSALUD is generated only from published schedules.
sinRol: There is no published schedule for this month.
sinTrabajador: Your user is not linked to a worker
sinTrabajadorTexto: Ask the HR unit to link your SIH SALUS user to your record in Frappe HR.
sinTurnosPasados: There are no completed shifts this month yet.
soloLectura: You can view this schedule but not edit it.
syncHayErrores: Some changes could not be synchronized
syncHayPendientes: There are changes waiting to be synchronized
syncTexto: Staff data moves between SIH SALUS and the HR system automatically; failed events are retried 3 times.
